purpose: Stabilize deployable-policy evidence for the frozen 15315 THREE_HANDED semantic Advantage teacher before any 15315 result is observed.

rebuild_plan.extension_rule: If and only if all build/integrity gates pass but the frozen K=8 rebuild-stability gate fails, add exactly members 9-12 using their already-frozen seeds, recompute the same metrics over all 12, and change no threshold. No external strength benchmark may be inspected before this branch resolves.
rebuild_plan.failure_rule: A scientifically failed member is never dropped or replaced. A mechanically corrupted run may be rerun only with the identical member id, inputs and seeds after the execution defect is fixed and documented.

specialist.route: postflop made_category>=TRIPS AND FOLD legal -> specialist; otherwise member fullpool general

aggregation.averaging: Arithmetic mean of each member's final legal action-probability vector after that member applies the frozen fullpool/specialist route; renormalize only for numerical epsilon after legality masking.
aggregation.deployment_compression_rule: If a future runtime/latency gate makes the full ensemble infeasible, open a separate preregistered compression/deployment experiment. A single medoid or distilled policy does not inherit ensemble validation automatically.

rebuild_stability_gate.balanced_half_splits: Enumerate all 35 unordered 4-vs-4 partitions at K=8. At K=12, enumerate a deterministic frozen set of 100 balanced 6-vs-6 partitions generated from seed 153159011.
mandatory_reporting: all 28 pairwise member TVs at K=8 or all 66 at K=12
per-state member mean/std/min/max for every rare-tail surface
all split-half metrics, not only passing summaries
argmax disagreement overall and by rare-tail surface

quality_and_safety_gate.ensemble_quality_rule: Apply the frozen 10315 architecture-quality criteria to the aggregate candidate on fresh 15315 evaluation data; thresholds are not relaxed after observing 15315.
rare_tail_rules: Report 72o preflop ALL_IN, trips-plus Fold, and postflop high-card/no-draw ALL_IN at member and ensemble levels.
No rare diagnostic state, DC1 state, deal, sampled action or pathology example may enter rebuild training or member selection.
No new unexpected sanity code is allowed without stopping for adjudication.

external_strength_gate.dc1_rule: Use fresh seed 153159301 on exactly 5000 scenarios for 15315 ensemble, accepted 10115 and frozen 10105 with identical scenarios/deals. Advancement requires exact HU parity, safety PASS, positive paired 3H 15315-minus-10115 mean and CI95 lower bound > 0. Otherwise report NEGATIVE or INCONCLUSIVE without changing rebuild members, seeds or thresholds.
external_strength_gate.dc2_rule: Only after DC0 PASS and the fresh DC1 advancement gate may seed 153159401 be opened for DC2 with at least 100000 sampled states under BENCH-006/BENCH-007.

performance_gate_requirements: Benchmark sequential reference and candidate process-parallel profiles on exact reduced rebuild workloads.
Require identical sample identities/order, final model tensors/losses and reports for parity cases.
Measure wall time, CPU, peak RSS, MemAvailable and swap.
Do not fan out unused multi-GB checkpoints into workers.
Require at least 1.25x speedup and at least 30 minutes projected net savings for a parallel profile to replace sequential execution.
Require at least 4 GiB minimum MemAvailable and at most 1 GiB swap use.

anti_cherry_picking: All 12 member seed families are frozen before teacher 15315 is observed.
K=8 versus K=12 is decided only by the frozen stability gate, never by strength or pathology outcomes.
No member weighting, member dropping, seed replacement, threshold relaxation or fresh-seed shopping is allowed after results.
The stability/quality/safety banks are disjoint from rebuild-training seeds and from prior observed DC1/common-state diagnostics.
Exact DC1/DC2 states, deals and sampled actions remain excluded from training and model selection under VALID-025.
